text: - 欢迎回到我的课程-- 欢迎回到我的课程-大家好,欢迎回到我的课程请把学生的书和工作室准备好今天我们将学习用上和用不上并问WH的问题和如何的问题在课程的部分首先,我们先试试读书的课程我带了几个问题给你张家人在哪里生活?他们住在一个小房子他的父亲做什么工作?他的父亲居住在一家中国餐厅张家人有什么愿望?他的愿望是成为建筑家或工程师A和N叫做不定贯词请记住这三个词我们试试用A和N我们用A和N在一个单字上为什么我们有时用A有时用N在一个单字上看看,这是法律我们用A在话中开始用相对音和N在话中开始用声a 应该用在以福音因素开头的字母或单词前n 应该用在以原音因素开头的字母或单词前In the first two sentences, we use a before small, Chinese, because these words begin with the consonant sounds.In the last sentence, we use an before architect and engineer, because these words begin with the vowel sounds.Now let's do some practice.Some students are talking about their ambitions.Complete sentences with a or an.It's exercise B on page 9 of your student's book.Let's check.Have you got all the answers correct?We use an before architect, English teacher and actor, because these words begin with the vowel sounds.When these students talk about their ambitions, they use different sentence patterns.What are they?One's ambition is to be.I want to be.I would like to be.And we can also use I dream of being.So what would you like to be?Please talk about your dream jobs with a partner.Let's share Nina and Jeff's dialogue.You want to make a lot of money, right?Not really.I want to be a businesswoman because I am good at doing business.Last school food festival, I helped my class raise a lot of money.That's true.You've got a talent.Besides talent, honesty is important as well.I promise I will be an honest businesswoman.Now answer the questions according to their dialogue.What would Jeff like to be?And why?He dreams of being a policeman because he wants to keep our city a safe place.He will wear a uniform.Kids, pay attention to a uniform.Here we use ㄚ instead of M because the letter U in the word uniform is pronounced as ㄛ.It's a consonant sound.So remember the tip.We use ㄚ before vowel letters with consonant sounds.For example, a uniform.Can you think of more examples we've learned?Do you still remember what Nina's dream job is?She wants to be an honest businesswoman.An honest businesswoman.Here ㄚ is a consonant letter.But we use ㄩ instead of ㄚ.Do you know why?Because here ㄚ is silent.And the beginning sound of the word honest is ㄛ.Here is another tip.We use ㄚ before words beginning with silent consonant letters followed by a vowel sound.For example, an honest person.Can you give more examples?Please read of me.An hour.An honor.Kids, please remember.It is not the written letter but the sound at the beginning of the word which determines whether ㄚ or ㄚ is used.So whether to use ㄚ or ㄚ.The key is to see if the beginning of the word is ㄚ or ㄚ.Let's check the answers.Why do you use ㄚ before SPCA officer?When we meet letters or abbreviations, we should pay attention to the sounds, not the letters themselves.Why do you use ㄚ before European country?Because ㄧ in European is silent here.ㄩ is pronounced as ㄩ.In the last two sentences, untidy and university both begin with the letter ㄩ.But why are your answers different?Though they have the same beginning letter ㄩ, ㄩ in untidy is pronounced as ㄚ.It's a vowel sound.So we should use ㄩ.While ㄩ in university is pronounced as ㄩ.We should use ㄚ.Now I'm sure you can use ㄚ or ㄩ correctly.Look, May received another letter from another pen friend, Peter.Peter missed ㄚ or ㄩ in his letter.So May found it hard to read it.Let's help Peter add ㄚ or ㄩ where necessary in his letter.The first one has been done for you.It's task two on your worksheet.Thank you for watching.What is this letter about?It's about Peter's school, family and hobbies.Now May has understood the letter.She and her mom are talking about Peter's letter.Complete the conversation.Complete the conversation below using the question words in the box.It's task three on your worksheet.Kids, these questions all start with ㄛ, how.We call them question words.We use question words to find out things.They usually come at the beginning of questions.And people usually use short answers in conversations.Let's do some practice.Match the ㄛ question words with the information they ask about.It's task four on your worksheet.Kids, let's check.We use ㄛ to ask about reason.It's quite easy for you, right?Next, write down how question words according to the information they ask about.It's task five on your worksheet.May wanted to know more about Peter's hobbies.So she asked some questions in her letter and Peter replied carefully.Please finish the exercise.It's task six on your worksheet.Kids, read May's questions again.What are these words in the box?They are auxiliary, a modal verb, and a verb B.So here's a tip.When you ask questions with question words, we usually put in auxiliary, a modal verb, or a verb B in front of the subject.当我们用特殊疑问词提问时,我们需要将助动词、情态动词和鼻动词放在主语前。Here are two John's friends at Walker School.Write some questions to ask about them, using the notes to help.After you finish the exercise, you can use the checklist below to check your answers.It's task seven on your worksheet.Write some questions to ask about them, using the checklist below to check your answers.The following questions are for your reference.Zhang has many friends at school.I'm sure you also have many friends at home.I'm sure you also have many friends.Please talk about your friends with a partner.On April the 20th?Me too.How does she look?She is a beautiful girl with long black hair.Her eyes can talk.Why do you think she is your best friend?Is it because she is beautiful?Of course not.True beauty comes from within.I like her because she is so friendly and helpful.What's her hobby?She likes music and plays the piano very well.I like music too.What would she like to be?She wants to be an English teacher.Her English is the best in her class.What sport is she good at?Swimming and playing table tennis.How many brothers and sisters does she have?She has an elder brother.He is a university student.What are her parents?Her mother is an architect, and her father is a doctor.Nina, from the dialogue, I know something about your best friend, Nancy.What about your friends, Jeff?You can talk about your friends with Nina after class.In this period, we talk about the rules of using a or an, and use WH and how questions to ask about information.This is your homework.This is the end of today's class.See you next time.
